title: Adder circuit evaluation
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every Boolean assignment $x$ to $n$ input bits, the adder circuit's output equals the conjunction of the following two conditions: the first $n/3$ bits of $x$, the next $n/3$ bits, and the subsequent $n/3$ bits agree bit by bit with the sum bits produced by binary addition of the first two blocks; and the final carry from adding the first two blocks is false.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean assignment to $n$ input bits
